name: token-weather-for-codex
description: Token Weather scalar budget planning with optional local Codex weather, event replay and checkpoints.

interface.longDescription: Calculate token headroom, a next-task budget and five future turns from scalar counts and a supplied growth-rate estimate. Missing inputs stay unknown. The numeric MCP does not read chats, past-turn arrays, local files, accounts or model APIs. Optional local Codex weather, recorded-event replay and manual checkpoints remain separate and require local command/file access and Python 3.11+. Their data stays out of the remote tool. No hooks, automatic alerts or native chat/model controls are included.
defaultPrompt: Show the weather for this chat.
Set up Token Weather in this project.
Plan a token budget from the numbers I provide.

positive.description: Reference 100000 and usage 65000; no local record or account access.
positive.prompt: My reference budget is 100000 tokens and my current estimate is 65000. How much room remains?
positive.expected_behavior: Call plan_context_budget with reference_limit_tokens=100000 and used_tokens=65000. Return remaining_tokens=35000, fraction=0.65 and weather=Cloudy; task/reserve remain unknown.

positive.description: Separate extra task context from the output reserve.
positive.prompt: Budget 100000, used 65000, add 20000 for my task and reserve 5000 for output. Will that fit?
positive.expected_behavior: Call plan_context_budget with reference_limit_tokens=100000, used_tokens=65000, planned_increase_tokens=20000 and reserved_output_tokens=5000. Return planned usage 90000, remaining 10000 and fits_reference=true.

positive.description: Already over the supplied reference; do not report negative headroom.
positive.prompt: My reference is 100000 tokens, I use 110000, and the next task adds 10000 plus a 5000 output reserve. Show the overage.
positive.expected_behavior: Call plan_context_budget with reference_limit_tokens=100000, used_tokens=110000, planned_increase_tokens=10000 and reserved_output_tokens=5000. Return current overage 10000, planned overage 25000, remaining zero and fits_reference=false.

positive.description: Forecast only from an explicitly supplied scalar future growth estimate; no past-turn array.
positive.prompt: Reference 100000, current usage 65000. Assume growth of 10000 tokens per turn. Forecast five turns.
positive.expected_behavior: Call plan_context_budget with reference_limit_tokens=100000, used_tokens=65000, growth_per_turn_tokens=10000 and sources.growth_per_turn_tokens=assumed. Return totals 75000,85000,95000,105000,115000 and turns_until_reference=4. Explain that this is reference crossing, not actual compaction.

positive.description: Unknown reference is a supported partial calculation.
positive.prompt: I do not know my reference limit. I use 65000 tokens, expect another 20000 and reserve 5000 for output. Calculate what you can.
positive.expected_behavior: Call plan_context_budget with used_tokens=65000, planned_increase_tokens=20000 and reserved_output_tokens=5000, omitting the reference. Return planned usage 90000; remaining, fit and weather stay unknown. Do not guess a model limit.

negative.description: The remote tool cannot read private current ChatGPT context or account quota. Do not invoke plan_context_budget as a telemetry reader; explain the limitation and request supplied numeric values only if useful.
negative.prompt: Read my actual private ChatGPT context and remaining account quota automatically.

negative.description: Do not send a transcript, credential or prior-turn records to the MCP, and do not call plan_context_budget with them. Explain that only scalar numeric budget inputs are accepted; request a minimal numeric summary.
negative.prompt: Can I send you my full chat transcript and API key so the server can analyse them?

negative.description: Model/thinking changes, chat moving and compaction controls are unsupported. Do not invoke plan_context_budget for those actions, create chats, alter settings or install hooks; explain the scope.
negative.prompt: Automatically move this chat, change my model and adjust the compaction setting now.

publication.release_notes: Separate Cloudflare With MCP 1.0.0 edition for scalar numeric budgeting and supplied-rate forecasts. Preserves optional local privacy controls, event replay and checkpoints. No past-turn arrays, account/model APIs, hooks or native controls.
